prior_actions.outcome: Each arm had 10,000 sessions. Control: 900 clicks and USD 50,000 purchase revenue. Variant: 1,500 clicks and USD 30,000 revenue. Clicks per session increased from 0.09 to 0.15; revenue per recorded session declined from USD 5 to USD 3, a 40% reduction. The analysis concluded the revenue objective was not met and recommended reversion.
prior_actions.applicability: The same audience and intervention make this stronger decision evidence than the click-focused summary. The aggregate data support the observed revenue decline, not a claim of statistical significance or a proven psychological mechanism.
